snippet.title: Home Sweet Gnome - Animated Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Home Sweet Gnome - a charming hand-painted adventure filled to the brim with Nordic folklore...

Play as Saga, a small gnome with big dreams, as she opens a Bed and Breakfast for creatures from Nordic folklore! Welcome guests, decorate rooms, explore the forest and make strange friends in this cozy, hand-painted adventure.

Home Sweet Gnome by Elva Entertainment is currently in development.

Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3819560/Home_Sweet_Gnome/

Follow us to stay up to date on all things Home Sweet Gnome!
